			/* ================================================================
   NLNG SCHOLARSHIPS - MASTER STYLESHEET v3.1
   SurveyMonkey Apply - Unified branding & Layout Fixes
   Palette: Green #005A36 | Navy #002D62 | Ink #1A202C
   ================================================================ */

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Maven+Pro:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

/* ================================================================
   1. TOKENS / RESET
   ================================================================ */

:root {
  --nln-green:        #005A36;
  --nln-green-dark:   #00462B;
  --nln-green-soft:   #EDF6F0;
  --nln-navy:         #002D62;
  --nln-navy-mid:     #174568;
  --nln-ink:          #1A202C;
  --nln-body:         #3A4A59;
  --nln-muted:        #6B7A88;
  --nln-line:         #E2E8F0;
  --nln-line-soft:    #EEF3F5;
  --nln-bg:           #F5F7F9;
  --nln-card:         #FFFFFF;
  --nln-radius:       10px;
  --nln-radius-lg:    12px;
  --nln-shadow-sm:    0 2px 7px rgba(20, 40, 55, .035);
  --nln-shadow-md:    0 4px 14px rgba(20, 40, 55, .06);
  --nln-shadow-lg:    0 9px 23px rgba(20, 40, 55, .10);
  --nln-grad:         linear-gradient(115deg, #005A36 0%, #003F50 55%, #002D62 100%);
}

html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }

body, #survey, #survey-form, .sma-applicant-task-row,
input, select, textarea, button, label {
  font-family: 'Maven Pro', Arial, sans-serif !important;
}

body {
  background-color: var(--nln-bg);
  color: var(--nln-ink);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

::selection { background: rgba(0, 90, 54, .18); }

a { color: var(--nln-green); }

/* ================================================================
   2. TOPBAR / HEADER FIXES (AGGRESSIVE)
   ================================================================ */

/* Base topbar (if class matches) */
.sma-topbar,
.sma-header,
#header,
.navbar,
.navbar-default,
.navbar-fixed-top,
.app-header,
.top-navbar,
header.topbar,
.sma-applicant-topbar {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nln-line) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .04) !important;
  color: var(--nln-ink) !important;
  padding: 14px 28px !important;
  position: relative;
  min-height: 64px;
}

/* Inner wrappers — some platforms put the dark bg on a child */
.sma-topbar > .container,
.sma-topbar > .container-fluid,
.sma-header > .container,
.sma-header > .container-fluid,
#header > .container,
#header > .container-fluid,
.navbar > .container,
.navbar > .container-fluid,
.navbar-collapse,
.navbar-header {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  background-color: #FFFFFF !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

/* Accent line under the topbar */
.sma-topbar::after,
.sma-header::after,
#header::after,
.navbar::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--nln-green), var(--nln-navy));
  opacity: .18;
}

/* Brand block */
.sma-topbar .sma-topbar-brand,
.sma-topbar .sma-topbar-logo-container,
.sma-topbar .sma-brand {
  position: absolute !important;
  left: 50% !important;
  top: 50% !important;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) !important;
  text-align: center !important;
  display: flex !important;
  flex-direction: column !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* All text inside topbar should be dark */
.sma-topbar a,
.sma-topbar span,
.sma-topbar i,
.sma-topbar div,
.sma-topbar p,
.sma-topbar .sma-topbar-brand-text,
.navbar a,
.navbar span,
.navbar i,
.navbar div,
.navbar p,
#header a,
#header span,
#header i,
#header div,
#header p,
header a,
header span,
header i,
header div,
header p {
  color: var(--nln-ink) !important;
  background: transparent !important;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Brand subtitle */
.sma-topbar .sma-topbar-brand-text,
.sma-topbar .brand-subtitle,
.navbar .brand-subtitle {
  color: var(--nln-navy) !important;
  font-size: 13px;
  letter-spacing: .3px;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Buttons inside topbar keep green */
.sma-topbar .btn,
.sma-topbar .sma-login-button,
.sma-topbar a[href*="login"],
.sma-topbar a[href*="apply"] {
  background: var(--nln-green) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-green) !important;
  color: #FFFFFF !important;
  border-radius: 7px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  padding: 9px 22px !important;
  min-height: 40px;
  transition: all .2s ease;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.sma-topbar .btn:hover,
.sma-topbar .sma-login-button:hover {
  background: var(--nln-green-dark) !important;
  border-color: var(--nln-green-dark) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 90, 54, .22);
}

/* Dropdown menus inside topbar */
.sma-topbar .dropdown-menu,
.navbar .dropdown-menu,
#header .dropdown-menu {
  background: #FFFFFF !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-line) !important;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(20, 40, 55, .12) !important;
}

.sma-topbar .dropdown-menu a,
.navbar .dropdown-menu a,
#header .dropdown-menu a {
  color: var(--nln-ink) !important;
}

.sma-topbar .dropdown-menu a:hover,
.navbar .dropdown-menu a:hover,
#header .dropdown-menu a:hover {
  background: var(--nln-green-soft) !important;
  color: var(--nln-green) !important;
}

/* ================================================================
   3. DASHBOARD / HOMEPAGE
   ================================================================ */

#maincontent { background-color: var(--nln-bg); }

#maincontent .container.main-content {
  max-width: 1180px;
  padding-top: 30px;
  padding-bottom: 40px;
}

#maincontent .sma-dashboard-custom-content {
  background: linear-gradient(120deg, #005A36 0%, #002D62 100%);

  padding: 35px 40px;
  margin-bottom: 35px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--nln-radius-lg);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 35, 45, .12);
}

#maincontent .sma-dashboard-custom-content > p:first-child {
  font-size: 27px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: #FFF;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
}

#maincontent .sma-dashboard-custom-content > p:not(:first-child) {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: #FFF;
  margin-bottom: 15px;
}

#maincontent .sma-applicant-program-card {
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 245px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 24px;
  background: var(--nln-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-line);
  border-top: 4px solid var(--nln-green);
  border-radius: 9px;
  box-shadow: var(--nln-shadow-md);
  transition: all .2s ease;
}

#maincontent .sma-applicant-program-card:hover {
  border-top-color: var(--nln-navy);
  box-shadow: var(--nln-shadow-lg);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

#maincontent .sma-applicant-program-title {
  color: var(--nln-navy);
  font-size: 19px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

#maincontent .sma-program-more {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--nln-green);
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-green);
  color: #FFF !important;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 10px 19px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  text-decoration: none;
}

/* ================================================================
   4. APPLICATION FORM (SURVEY)
   ================================================================ */

#survey { width: 100%; max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; }

#survey .survey-header {
  background: var(--nln-card);
  padding: 20px 22px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border: 1px solid #E1E8EC;
  border-radius: var(--nln-radius);
}

#survey .survey-title {
  color: var(--nln-navy);
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

#survey .survey-progress-outer {
  height: 9px;
  background: #E8EEF0;
  border-radius: 20px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

#survey .survey-progress-inner {
  height: 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--nln-green), var(--nln-navy)) !important;
  border-radius: 20px;
}

#survey-form .question:not(.section-separator):not(.buttons) {
  background: var(--nln-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-line);
  border-left: 3px solid #D8E8DF;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 17px 20px;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
  box-shadow: var(--nln-shadow-sm);
  transition: all .2s ease;
}

#survey-form .question:not(.section-separator):not(.buttons):focus-within {
  border-color: #8DB8A2;
  border-left-color: var(--nln-green);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 40, 55, .065);
}

#survey-form .question.section-separator {
  background: var(--nln-grad);
  border: none;
  border-radius: var(--nln-radius);
  padding: 22px 25px;
  margin: 24px 0 15px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0, 45, 40, .10);
}

#survey-form .question.section-separator .question-title,
#survey-form .question.section-separator .question-title p {
  color: #FFF !important;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
}

#survey-form .question-body input[type="text"],
#survey-form .question-body input[type="email"],
#survey-form .question-body input[type="tel"],
#survey-form .question-body input[type="number"],
#survey-form .question-body input[type="date"],
#survey-form .question-body select,
#survey-form .question-body textarea,
#survey-form .question-body .form-control {
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 10px 13px;
  background: #FFF;
  border: 1px solid #CCD6DF;
  border-radius: 7px;
  color: var(--nln-ink);
  font-size: 15px;
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 640px !important;
  transition: border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}

#survey-form .question-body input:focus,
#survey-form .question-body select:focus,
#survey-form .question-body textarea:focus {
  border-color: var(--nln-green);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0, 90, 54, .10);
  outline: none;
}

#survey-form .question-body ul.horizontal {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
}

#survey-form .question-body ul.horizontal li {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  background: #F7FAF8;
  border: 1px solid #DCE7E0;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 11px 16px;
  margin: 0;
}

#survey-form input[type="radio"],
#survey-form input[type="checkbox"] {
  accent-color: var(--nln-green);
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  margin-right: 7px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

#survey-form #next-submit-button {
  background: var(--nln-green) !important;
  border: 1px solid var(--nln-green) !important;
  color: #FFF !important;
  font-weight: 700;
  border-radius: 7px;
  min-height: 45px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
}

/* ================================================================
   5. UGSS PROGRAMME PAGE (Premium executive editorial design)
   ================================================================ */

#maincontent {
    background-color: #F2F4F3 !important;
    padding-top: 46px !important;
    padding-bottom: 88px !important;

#maincontent .container.main-content > .row > div:first-child { width: 74% !important; }

/* MAIN PROGRAMME DOCUMENT */

/* MASTHEAD */

			window.onload = function () {
				try {
					var leftNav = $(".js-sma-leftnav").filter(":visible").first();
					var skipBtn = document.getElementById("sma-skip-nav-btn");

					if (!leftNav.length && skipBtn) {
						$(skipBtn).hide();
						return;
					}
					if (skipBtn && leftNav.length) {
						var focusNav = function (e) {
							try {
								if (e) e.preventDefault();
								leftNav.focus();
							} catch (err) {
								console.error(err);
							}
						};
						skipBtn.addEventListener("click", focusNav);
						skipBtn.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
							try {
								if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
									focusNav(e);
								}
							} catch (err) {
								console.error(err);
							}
						});
					}
				} catch (err) {
					console.error(err);
				}
			};
		</script>
	</body>

	
	

</html>
